context: Traditional community/cultural hybrid fullstack app with multi-location support (Rewari & Mathura), warm saffron, cream, and deep red accents.

layouts.header: sticky top-0 z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#FFFBEB]/90 border-b border-amber-200/60

accessibility.contrast_target: WCAG AA (4.5:1 min for normal text)
accessibility.aria_support: Mandatory aria-labels and roles for location switchers, language toggle, and auth guards
accessibility.test_attributes: All interactive elements must include data-testid attributes

image_urls.description: Traditional Indian cultural heritage and temple saffron hues

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure location-aware context resolves Mathura and Rewari correctly via subdomain or switcher dropdown in header.
Support English and Hindi i18n toggling across navigation and static content.
Provide full config-driven branding for Mahawar Sabha.
Include admin panel skeleton with entity management tabs and authentication route-guard skeleton.
Make sure every interactive element has a data-testid attribute for robust testing.
